name: Pact of the Chain
description:
Learn Find Familiar without spending an ordinary spell selection. This test uses its 5.5e Chain mode: cast it as a Magic action without a slot, while retaining the spell's required components. Its ritual route remains available. Choose a special form: Imp, Pseudodragon, Quasit, Skeleton, Sphinx of Wonder, Sprite, or Venomous Snake. The normal animal forms from Find Familiar are also available. Use the relevant host-game references and tell us which statblock version you used.

The familiar shares your initiative but tracks its own turn, movement, action, and Reaction. Order the two turns together. Without an attack command, it can perform permitted non-Attack tasks normally. When you take the Attack action, forgo one of your attacks to command one familiar Attack action on its turn in that shared initiative round. At Warlock 5, that action contains two attacks. It does not gain a second Attack action or use its Reaction for this class command route.

Investment of the Chain Master can alternatively command that same action with your Bonus Action. Using both routes does not create another familiar Attack action. There is at most one commanded familiar Attack action per shared initiative round. The Warlock's ordinary Action stays available when the Bonus Action route is used. For this test, give the command before the familiar's attack resolution. Special non-Attack actions follow their statblocks; no blanket spell or summon action grant is created.
deepenedAtLevel5: At Warlock 5, the familiar makes two attacks in its one commanded Attack action. It does not gain a second Attack action. The base Attack-action command and Investment of the Chain Master Bonus Action command share the same single commanded Attack action per shared initiative round.
